findings.evidence: template/scripts/platform_doctor.py:187-197 checks only the step name and its position before platform_doctor, without checking its command or execution condition. An in-memory check replacing the repair command with `run: echo skipped` returned zero failures. The active ci-safety requirement requires repository-owned shared-workspace repair before platform_doctor and explicit failure when the preparation step disagrees with the answer.
findings.summary: The doctor accepts a named repair step that never executes shared-workspace repair.

findings.evidence: template/.github/workflows/dev-platform.yml.jinja:26 and template/.github/workflows/process-health-labels.yml.jinja:12 interpolate labels without quoting, including inside flow lists. Labels `null`, `123`, and `true` all satisfy the declared `[A-Za-z0-9._-]+` grammar, but the rendered YAML parses them as None, integer 123, and boolean True. template/scripts/platform_doctor.py:170-184 compares raw text and accepts these outputs. This violates the requirement that rendered jobs run on the declared self-hosted labels.
findings.summary: Permitted self-hosted labels can render as YAML null, numbers, or booleans instead of runner label strings.
